title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 404 South Boulder Highway in Henderson, Nevada, as the Henderson Veterans Memorial Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 404 South Boulder Highway in Henderson, Nevada, as the "Henderson Veterans Memorial Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Congress renamed a Postal Service building in Henderson, Nevada, as the Henderson Veterans Memorial Post Office Building.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a specific Postal Service facility at 404 South Boulder Highway in Henderson, Nevada, a new official name. The building is now called the Henderson Veterans Memorial Post Office Building. The law does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on August 21, 2019.
